title: The Crooked Hollow
author: I. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Yara Dravenmoor, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
